notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Insect.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
